name: amenui
description: 组件以源码分发：把 files 里的文件和 dependencies 里各项的文件拷进自己的项目，再按需要改。组件只依赖框架的 el 模块（界面树）和 taffy 的对齐类型。
description_en: Components are distributed as source: copy the files in `files`, and those of each entry in `dependencies`, into your project and change them as you need. Components depend only on the framework's el module (the interface tree) and taffy's alignment types.

items.name: base
items.title: 共用尺寸
items.description: 组件共用的尺寸（字号、控件高度、线宽、圆角）和选中时的颜色。每个组件都用到它。
items.description_en: The sizes every component shares (type sizes, control heights, line widths, corner radii) and the selection colour. Every component uses it.

items.name: button
items.title: 按钮
items.description: 执行一个操作。按下时立即触发，也可以用 Enter 或空格键触发。
items.description_en: Perform an action. It fires on press, and Enter or Space fire it too.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: number
items.title: 数字
items.description: 精确设置一个数值：获得焦点后直接键入，或用方向键和两侧的按钮按步长改；在数值上横向拖动可以连续调。
items.description_en: Set a value exactly: type it once focused, or step it with the arrow keys and the buttons on either side; drag across the value to scrub it.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: its value text ({key}/shown) recomposes when the value changes

items.name: input
items.title: 输入框
items.description: 输入一行或多行文字（textarea）。可以点、拖动、双击选择，Shift 加方向键扩展选区；Ctrl / ⌘ 加 A、C、X、V、Z 全选、复制、剪切、粘贴、撤销；支持输入法，正在组字的部分画在插入点上，带下划线。
items.description_en: Enter one line or several (textarea). Click, drag or double-click to select, Shift with the arrows to extend; Ctrl / ⌘ with A, C, X, V, Z to select all, copy, cut, paste and undo; input methods are supported, with the composition drawn underlined at the caret.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: never (typing is immediate)

items.name: switch
items.title: 开关
items.description: 在两种状态之间切换一项设置。
items.description_en: Turn a setting on or off.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: slider
items.title: 滑块
items.description: 在一个范围内大致地选一个值。需要精确的值时，用数字控件。
items.description_en: Pick a value roughly within a range. For an exact value, use a number control.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: tabs
items.title: 标签页
items.description: 在同一位置的几组内容之间切换。
items.description_en: Switch between groups of content in the same place.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: choice
items.title: 选项
items.description: 从几个互斥的选项中选一个。
items.description_en: Choose one of a few mutually exclusive options.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: list
items.title: 列表
items.description: 显示一组条目，可以选中其中一项；条目多时可以滚动。
items.description_en: Show a set of items, one of which can be selected; it scrolls when there are many.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: menu
items.title: 菜单
items.description: 按钮显示当前选项；按下后在它下方的一层里列出全部选项。按一项选中它，按列表以外的地方或 Esc 关闭。
items.description_en: A button that shows the current option; pressing it lists every option in a layer below it. Press one to choose it; press outside the list or Esc to close.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: card
items.title: 卡片
items.description: 把相关的内容放在一个带边框的区域里。
items.description_en: Keep related content together in a bordered area.
items.response: inherits (text inside is nudged and legible)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: dialog
items.title: 对话框
items.description: 在页面之上显示需要处理的内容。关闭之前，页面的其余部分不响应操作；Esc 或关闭按钮关闭它。
items.description_en: Show content that needs attention above the page. Until it closes, the rest of the page does not respond; Esc or the close button closes it.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: image
items.title: 图片
items.description: 按原比例显示一张图片。图片松开时变成记号；指针在图上移动时，图会在指针附近松开。
items.description_en: Show a picture at its own aspect ratio. A loosened picture turns into marks; under the pointer it loosens nearby.
items.response: loosen (decoration)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: divider
items.title: 分隔线
items.description: 分开两组内容。
items.description_en: Separate two groups of content.
items.response: loosen (decoration)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: 滚动区
items.description: 在固定的高度里显示更长的内容，用滚轮滚动；一侧的细条表示当前位置。
items.description_en: Show longer content in a fixed height, scrolled with the wheel; a thin bar at one side shows the position.
items.response: inherits (text inside is nudged and legible)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: orbit
items.title: 三维视图
items.description: 转动一个三维视图：拖动环绕，滚轮推近拉远，获得焦点后方向键转动；快速拖动后松手会慢慢停下。相机是状态里的 Orbit，组件只报告输入。
items.description_en: Turn a 3D view: drag to orbit, the wheel to dolly, the arrow keys once focused; a quick drag coasts to a stop. The camera is an Orbit in the state; the component only reports input.
items.response: loosen (a 3D element is decoration, like a picture, even when it can be turned)
items.recompose: none (no text)

items.name: checkbox
items.title: 复选框
items.description: 选择一个选项是否适用，和别的选项无关。按下、空格或 Enter 切换。
items.description_en: Choose whether one option applies. Press, Space or Enter toggles.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: radio
items.title: 单选组
items.description: 在几个都看得见的选项里选一个。整组是一个焦点位置，方向键移动并选中。
items.description_en: Choose one of a few visible options. One focus stop; the arrows move and select.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: select
items.title: 选择框
items.description: 从按需打开的列表里选一项。Enter、空格或 ↓ 打开，↑ ↓ 移动，Enter 选中，Esc 关上。
items.description_en: Choose one option from a list that opens on demand.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: tooltip
items.title: 提示
items.description: 控件被悬停或获得焦点时显示的一句说明。
items.description_en: A short description shown while a control is hovered or focused.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: popover
items.title: 浮层
items.description: 锚在按钮下面、按需打开的一层内容。
items.description_en: Rich content in a layer anchored to a button.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: toast
items.title: 通知
items.description: 角落里一条简短的通知，过一会儿自己消失。
items.description_en: A brief notice in a corner that goes away by itself.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: progress
items.title: 进度
items.description: 一项工作做到哪里了，或者正在进行。
items.description_en: How far a task has come, or that it is going on.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: accordion
items.title: 折叠面板
items.description: 每个标题下一段可以展开、收起的内容。
items.description_en: Sections that open and close under their headings.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: table
items.title: 表格
items.description: 有列名的一行行记录。整张表一个焦点位置，↑ ↓ 换选中的行。
items.description_en: Rows of records with named columns.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: badge
items.title: 徽标
items.description: 表示状态或数量的小标签。
items.description_en: A small label for a status or a count.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: avatar
items.title: 头像
items.description: 用名字的首字母代表一个人（不用照片）。
items.description_en: Stands for a person by their initials (no pictures).
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: skeleton
items.title: 骨架
items.description: 内容还没来时按它的形状占位。更好的做法是在真实的行上写 El::skeleton()：同一棵树、同样的布局，字画成量出来的行宽的条，图片画成块；Loading 的规则（skeleton_after_ms 300 以后才出骨架，换内容时每行错开 swap_stagger_ms 40）决定什么时候画什么，换上内容时框不动。
items.description_en: Holds the place of content that is still loading. Better: El::skeleton() on the real rows — the same tree and layout, text drawn as bars of the measured line widths, pictures as blocks; the Loading rules (a skeleton only after skeleton_after_ms 300, rows swapped in swap_stagger_ms 40 apart) decide what shows, and nothing moves when the content comes.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: 面包屑
items.description: 这一页在层级里的位置，每一级都能回去。
items.description_en: Where this page is in a hierarchy, each level a link back.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: skip-link
items.title: 跳到正文
items.description: 键盘用户最先遇到的链接，把焦点跳过导航，直接移到正文。
items.description_en: A link keyboard users meet first that moves focus past the navigation to the main content.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: pagination
items.title: 分页
items.description: 在结果的各页之间移动。
items.description_en: Move between pages of results.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: sheet
items.title: 抽屉
items.description: 从窗口一侧盖上来的一块面板，页面仍然看得见。
items.description_en: A panel over one side of the window.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: context_menu
items.title: 右键菜单
items.description: 指针下的东西能做的命令，在那里打开。
items.description_en: Commands for what is under the pointer, opened where it is.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: command
items.title: 命令面板
items.description: 打字找到并执行一个命令（⌘K / Ctrl+K）。
items.description_en: Find and run a command by typing.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: toggle
items.title: 切换按钮
items.description: 一直按着的按钮（粗体、斜体），或一组这样的按钮。
items.description_en: A button that stays pressed, or a group of them.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: bottom_sheet
items.title: 底部面板
items.description: 从底边升起的面板：按把手或正文拖动，停在几档高度之间；往下甩就收起。松手时的速度交给弹簧，停在哪一档由这个速度能把它带到哪里决定；拉过最高一档会越拉越难；正文里的滚动到顶以后再往下拉就变成拖面板。Esc 收起。面板升起和拖动时在场图里留下尾迹（`El::stirr`，强弱由预设定）。
items.description_en: A panel that rises from the bottom edge: dragged by its handle or body between detents, swiped down to dismiss. The release velocity carries on into a spring; where it rests is decided by where that velocity would take it; past the top detent it resists; a scroll inside hands off to the sheet at its top. Esc dismisses. Rising and dragged, it leaves a trail in the field map (`El::stirr`; the preset sets how strong).
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: floating
items.title: 浮动窗口
items.description: 浮在一块区域上的小框（画中画）：随便拖，松手后按甩出去的方向和速度投射出终点，用弹簧滑到离终点最近的角。获得焦点后方向键换角。拖动、甩出和滑到角上时在场图里留下尾迹（`El::stirr`，强弱由预设定），经过的装饰松开一点、顺着动的方向漂开。
items.description_en: A small box floating over an area (picture in picture): drag it anywhere; let go, the throw's projected end picks the nearest corner and a spring takes it there. Arrow keys move it between corners. Dragged, thrown and gliding, it leaves a trail in the field map (`El::stirr`; the preset sets how strong): decoration it passes loosens a little and drifts the way it went.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: caption
items.title: 公式注
items.description: 实时演示下面的一行等宽小字：印出驱动它的真实参数（从同一些字段读出来，不是手写的），每个参数也是一个能改的数字控件。El::caption_params 把它放在演示下面。
items.description_en: A small monospaced line under a live demo that prints the parameters driving it (read from the same fields, never typed by hand), each also a number control. El::caption_params puts it under the demo.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: nested_menu
items.title: 多级菜单
items.description: 行可以打开子菜单的菜单，按指针往哪里去来决定：指针在“上一处位置到子菜单两个近角”的三角形里朝子菜单移动时，经过的兄弟行不会接管（每次移动重新等 close_delay_ms，默认 200 ms）；在三角形外，停在一行上 submenu_delay_ms（默认 120 ms）后它接管。方向键、Enter、Esc；可以把三角形画出来（标注层）。
items.description_en: A menu whose rows open submenus, steered by where the pointer heads: moving toward an open submenu inside the triangle from its previous position to the submenu's near corners does not switch rows (each move waits close_delay_ms again, 200 ms); outside it, a row takes over after submenu_delay_ms (120 ms). Arrow keys, Enter, Esc; the triangle can be drawn (annotation layer).
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: keyed labels recompose when their text changes

items.name: card_stack
items.title: 卡片叠
items.description: 一叠卡片：悬停或按下一张，它下面的卡片绕左下角展开，第 n 张转 angle0 × falloff^n（默认 42° × 0.7^n），晚 delay_ms × n（默认 28 ms）开始，各自用弹簧。卡片是三维元素，所以样子跟着材质：平的、带厚度能看见边的、或者由记号（点阵、ASCII）画出来的。展开和落定时每张卡片在场图里留下一小段尾迹（`El::stirr`）。
items.description_en: A stack of cards: hover or press one and the cards beneath fan out about their bottom-left corners, card n turning angle0 × falloff^n (42° × 0.7^n) and starting delay_ms × n (28 ms) later, each on its own spring. The cards are a 3D element, so the look follows the material: flat, thick with visible edges, or drawn in marks (dots, ASCII). Fanning out and settling, each card leaves a short trail in the field map (`El::stirr`).
items.response: loosen (a 3D element is decoration, like a picture, even when it can be turned)
items.recompose: none (no text)

items.name: dot_chart
items.title: 点阵图表
items.description: 一条曲线画成一片点：每一列从轴往上填到曲线，点的大小和亮度说它有多少在曲线下面（面积就是曲线下的面积）；一段范围用强调色；指针扫过时一条竖线和那里的值；轴上的控制点可以拖，曲线跟着重算。标签用等宽（像素）字。
items.description_en: A series as a field of dots: each column filled from the axis up to the curve, a dot's size and brightness saying how much of it lies under the curve (the area reads as the area under it); a range in the accent colour; a scrubbing marker with the value; control points on the axis that drag the curve live. Labels in the mono (pixel) face.
items.response: nudge (a control: pushed as one piece by fronts, held and condensing at most to Look::legible_cap)
items.recompose: the value label does not recompose (it follows the pointer)

scenes.name: body
scenes.what: The landing page: a passage, first a readable page, gathers into a slowly turning luminous body of its own glyphs (the skin, conserved) and some eleven thousand budgeted volume marks, lit by one key light, over a reflection pool and drifting dust; it goes back to readable text.
rest_states: page: every glyph where the layout put it, no pose (after the first 2.4 s)
body: turning slowly and breathing (its only motion)
scenes.input: click, Space or Enter toggles; drag turns; ← → nudge the turn; the markings in the picture (form, seed, gather / release, language, Lab, components)

materials.name: plain
materials.description: 什么都不散成单元：前沿照样推动，新出现的照样凝聚（淡入）；底子是平的。
materials.description_en: Nothing loosens into units: fronts still push and new things still condense (as a fade); the ground is flat.

materials.name: dottr
materials.description: 全局的点阵：松开的字按下面的墨散成单元，底子是一片小单元。
materials.description_en: The global dot lattice: loosening text breaks into units sized by the ink under them, and the ground is a field of small units.

materials.name: halftonr
materials.description: 墨是转过角度的网点，第二种颜色套印错开。
materials.description_en: Ink as round dots on a rotated screen, with the second colour out of register.

materials.name: charr
materials.description: 墨是按亮度挑出的字符，排在格子上。
materials.description_en: Ink as characters chosen by brightness, on a grid.

materials.name: smudgr
materials.description: 粗糙的印刷：纸纹、错位的专色、斑点和洇开。
materials.description_en: Lo-fi print: paper grain, misregistered spot ink, specks and bleed.

materials.name: carvr
materials.description: 木刻：沿轮廓一条条刻出的刀痕。
materials.description_en: Linocut: carved gouges along the outline, in bands.

materials.name: glitchr
materials.description: 松开时，行横向错开、颜色分离、块重复。
materials.description_en: Rows that slip sideways, colour fringes and held blocks while something is loose.

materials.name: near
materials.description: 把中间的图像画出来：带符号的距离画成等高的带，轮廓，和每个实例的松开度。
materials.description_en: The intermediate images made visible: the signed nearness as contour bands, the outline, and each instance's looseness as a tint.

materials.name: scribblr
materials.description: 一根线把墨写出去再写回来：静止时是 plain，松开时一根等宽的线离开轮廓，在场有能量的地方打结。
materials.description_en: One thread writes the ink out and back: at rest the page is plain; loosened, a line of constant width leaves the outline and knots where the field map has energy.

materials_description_en: Materials are distributed as source too: `amenui add material <name>` copies `src/materials/<name>.wgsl`; change it and add it with `Look::material_source` under a name of its own.
